definitions.compute: Union of all non-NCCL GPU kernels, including elementwise/copy kernels; excludes GPU memcpy/memset activities.
definitions.overlap: Intersection of communication interval union and compute interval union on the same rank.
definitions.no_noncomm_kernel: Communication executing without a concurrent non-NCCL kernel. NOT a proven counterfactual step-time saving.
definitions.caveats: One profiled step per rank; not unprofiled control timing. Kernel time includes peer waits. Overlap can contend for resources. Groups/phases are not necessarily additive.
